Run the website locally

From this extracted directory run python -m http.server 8000 --directory dist, then open http://127.0.0.1:8000/. Browser workers require HTTP; do not open the tools as file URLs.

Reproduce the scientific cases

Run node research/build_submission_cases.mjs. Actual case arrays are in dist/data/submission-2026/, including 16 cooling-map trajectories and the three Robin-refinement runs. The summary records numerical source hashes. An independent Robin input and SciPy comparison are in its reference subdirectory.

Run the Node test command recorded in manifest.json. The Python reference uses NumPy/SciPy; plots use Matplotlib; document generation uses ReportLab/PyPDF and Windows Arial fonts. HTML/PDF articles are already built. Browser QA additionally uses Playwright and Edge.

Before submission

Submit through Moment at https://scientificintelligence.org/onboarding?campaign=osi-hackathon-2026. Each member signs in and joins the project team; one member submits a public video/post link, one-page write-up, code link and the platforms used. The video limit is four minutes. A narrated 3:38 film is prepared separately from this source archive. The official deadline is 00:00 UTC on 23 October 2026. Save the platform confirmation after submitting.
